title: Anatomy of a Paradigm Shift: Why the Transformer Architecture Redefined Natural Language Processing
hook: By systematically eliminating recurrence and convolution in favor of pure self-attention, the Transformer architecture removed computational bottlenecks and enabled scaling laws that fundamentally altered the NLP landscape.

sections.heading: The Recurrence Bottleneck: Limitations of RNNs and LSTMs
key_points: Sequential processing prevents parallelization across time steps, causing severe GPU underutilization during training.
Vanishing and exploding gradients degrade the network's ability to model long-range token dependencies.
Hidden state compression forces all contextual history through a fixed-size vector bottleneck.

sections.heading: Scaled Dot-Product and Multi-Head Self-Attention Mechanisms
key_points: Query, Key, and Value projections compute dense pairwise token affinities via matrix multiplication.
Scaling factor division by the square root of the key dimension prevents gradient saturation in high-dimensional spaces.
Multi-head projections allow the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces concurrently.

sections.heading: Positional Encodings and Permutation Invariance
key_points: Self-attention treats input as an unordered set, necessitating explicit injection of token order information.
Sinusoidal frequency bases allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than those seen during training.
Modern variants utilize learned absolute embeddings or Rotary Position Embeddings to preserve relative spatial geometry.

sections.heading: Unlocking Scaling Laws and Foundation Models
key_points: Architectural uniformity and high hardware utilization paved the way for predictable power-law scaling in parameter counts.
Self-supervised pre-training on massive corpora supplanted task-specific feature engineering with universal representations.
In-context learning emerged as an emergent capability, shifting the paradigm from fine-tuning to prompt-based inference.

conclusion_point: The Transformer's replacement of sequential recurrence with parallelizable self-attention transformed NLP from a domain of brittle feature engineering into a unified, scale-driven science of foundation models.
topic: Why the Transformer architecture changed NLP
